title.narrative: Innovative Systems to Promote Integrated, Resilient and Enhanced Responses to Women and Girls Health

description.narrative: The objective of the Innovative Systems to Promote Integrated, Resilient, and Enhanced Responses to Women and Girls Health Project for Ethiopia is to improve women and girls health outcomes and strengthen health systems in climate-stressed areas. The project has four components. (1) Expand access to quality interventions for women and girls, including through tech-enabled care component will develop and implement a system-based cervical cancer prevention program using a community-based, digitally supported service delivery platform; Enhance HEWs capacity to provide quality care by establishing digital learning platforms for continuing education, performance management and certification of skill development, and capacity building to deliver basic preventive and promotive healthcare services for women and girls; Enhance service delivery availability and efficiency by purchasing and introducing portable AIenabled ultrasound machines for 500 healthcare centers; and Implement m-mama emergency response system by improving remote triage implementing a digitalized dispatch system, tracking patient outcomes using public ambulance and private taxi ambulances using the m-mama experience. (2) Improve service delivery through innovative interventions in climate-stressed and conflict-affected areas component will: provide renewable solar energy for 500 healthcare centers to provide adequate lighting in delivery rooms to enable safe nighttime deliveries for continuous service provision and avoid unnecessary referrals; implement waterless toilet technologies to improve WASH systems of 240 healthcare facilities in climate-stressed and water-scarce areas with high patient volumes; implement innovative environmental technology (Ecosterly) for medical waste management in four hospitals to support medical waste treatment and recycling; revise minimum design requirements for healthcare facility construction and renovation standards to include alternative renewable energy sources, digital connectivity standards, and materials to ensure facility resilience in times of climate-related shocks. (3) Strengthen data systems and reinforce decision-making to ensure high-quality care component will uild institutional capacity to implement health sector innovations, including integration of data generated through project-supported innovations; Improve decision-making capacity in big data analytics, modeling, and proactive surveillance using metrological, environmental, and public health data to predict the impact of climate change and design innovative solutions. (4) Project implementation and monitoring component will provide program management and implementation monitoring support, including supportive supervision of regional health bureaus (RHBs) and implementing entities, conduct mid-term and endline evaluations of implementation of innovative interventions that the project supports, including an impact evaluation of the m-mama emergency response, and omplement key innovations and sector reforms to address lingering women and girls health problems and accelerate progress toward the Sustainable Development Goals.

title.narrative: HEWs who complete required in-service training courses through digital learning platform.

comment.narrative: The project became effective in June 2025 and is currently in its early implementation phase. Initial activities undertaken include: 22,000 HEWs trained on selected IRT modules using the e-Learning platform; initiated tablet procurement; and preparation are underway to scale the training of the remaining HEWs through the e-Learning platform and AI assisted learning platform in 20 districts is underway.

title.narrative: Health facilities that have been enrolled in the m-mama program.

comment.narrative: The project became effective in June 2025 and is currently in its early implementation phase. Initial activities undertaken include: developed concept note for experience sharing on m-Mama in Tanzania/Malawi and local digital solutions for Urban (Addis Abeba) have been developed and ready for pilot.

title.narrative: Health facilities using AI-enabled ultrasound machines as part of routine care for pregnant women.

comment.narrative: The project became effective in June 2025 and is currently in its early implementation phase. Initial activities undertaken include: specification for AI enabled tablet developed, preparations for assessment of existing AI Enabled ultrasound in the Sidama region and procurement of the tablets are under way.

title.narrative: Health information technicians and related experts trained on data management, analysis and use of data for decision making.

comment.narrative: Training planning have been completed and the trainings will be provided in the coming months.

title.narrative: Health facilities supported with climate resilient and digital technologies to provide women and girls health services

comment.narrative: Facility Selection criteria have been developed and discussed and climate sensitive design is under development. The MoH is on track to achieve the PDO target for this indicator.

title.narrative: Girls (9- to 14-year-old) in school and out of school who receive HPV vaccination

comment.narrative: Following Project effectiveness in June 2025, the MoH finalized the institutionalization/routinization of HPV Vaccination for 9 years old adolescent girls, community mobilization and HCWs capacity building are well planned, and a catch-up campaign for those 10-14 years old and missed previous doses is planned. The needed quantity of HPV Vaccines has been distributed to the field level.

title.narrative: Eligible women who are screened for cervical cancer at health centers

comment.narrative: The project became effective in June 2025 and community mobilization & advocacy; training of healthcare workers, and procurement of inputs for expanding screening capacity have been on track. As of December 2025, 445,000 women's have been screened and the MoH is on track to achieve target.
